protocol.ap: score-ranked per-class one-to-one greedy IoU>=.5; 101-point precision interpolation
protocol.ap_empty_gt: class/pair AP null if no GT; exclude only null class/pair means; FP in empty images retained
protocol.ap_ties: descending score, lexicographic group key, original row index; GT row order fixed
protocol.confidence_filter: none added; evaluate every frozen output row
protocol.default_counts: maximum cardinality, then maximum total IoU; per image/class, no score reordering
protocol.degenerate_predictions: zero extent retained with IoU zero; nonfinite/inverted rows fail validation
protocol.occlusion: original audited XML occluded field, outside=1 excluded by parser
protocol.pair_macro: mean within-pair eligible-class AP50, then mean over eligible pairs
protocol.recovery: matched GT-node set difference vs native; maximum-cardinality tie-dependent diagnostic, not identity metric
protocol.scope: calibration detector readout only; no MDA/IDF1/MOTA
protocol.size: GT original-coordinate sqrt(area)<16 vs >=16, not min-side width
protocol.strata: GT strata report TP/FN/recall only; unmatched FP have no GT occlusion label
